relations: Pulling the wand outward increases the surface area, stretching the iridescent soap film into a larger bubble.
Variations in film thickness and viewing angle cause the rainbow colors to shift across the suspended surface.
Letting go of the wand detaches the bubble, allowing it to drift freely through the park air.
